Then read `roc_auc`, `balanced_accuracy_at_best_cut` and `cut_headroom`: if the ranking ceiling clears ~0.90 but `cut_headroom` is large, the next attempt tunes the class weight explicitly; if the ceiling is still short of the 0.9194 bar, the next attempt changes family<path> (xgboost with deeper trees, or a wider hist_gbdt) rather than the operating point.",

Relative to the card's baseline (logreg + median impute + standard scale, unweighted): different family (gbdt instead of linear), no imputation<path> (NaN handled natively by the splits), and class_weight='balanced' instead of the unweighted default cut.",
  "rationale": "The goal bar (0.9194 balanced_accuracy) sits above the baseline's own ranking ceiling (balanced_accuracy_at_best_cut 0.8266, KS 0.6531), so no threshold or weight on the logistic ranking can reach it — the ranking has to improve. On adult, with 102 one-hot levels, strong non-linearity (education-num x marital-status x capital-gain interactions) and heavily skewed capital-gain<path>, a boosted tree ensemble is the standard large step over a linear model on the ranking axis; it is also the one family here that can express the interactions the executor will not build as columns. hist_gbdt is the cheapest strong gbdt (cost 3) and fits 29k rows x ~108 encoded columns well inside 600s and 2GB. early_stopping is turned off deliberately so the fit sees all 29,304 rows and stays comparable to the baseline, with 400 iterations at lr 0.06 and l2 1.0 + min_samples_leaf 20 as the regularisation that replaces the stop. impute:none avoids inventing values in the three sparsely-missing categorical columns; missing_indicator is documented as producing bit-identical predictions alongside impute:none, so it would waste the attempt. class_weight='balanced' (ratio 3.18) is one point, not the optimum, on the operating-point axis — it is included because the baseline's recall (0.6072) is far below its specificity and balanced_accuracy is their mean; cut_headroom on this attempt will say whether the remaining gap is the cut or the ranking, and that decides attempt 2.",
